title: On Air Light
description: Configuration for the On Air sign plugin

mqtt_host.title: MQTT Broker Host
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker (e.g. your Home Assistant instance)

mqtt_username.title: MQTT Username
mqtt_username.description: Leave blank if no authentication is required

mqtt_password.title: MQTT Password
mqtt_password.description: Leave blank if no authentication is required

command_topic.title: Command Topic
command_topic.description: MQTT topic to subscribe to. Accepts ON/OFF or JSON {"state":"on","label":"RECORDING","color":[255,20,20],"bg":[0,0,0]}

state_topic.title: State Topic
state_topic.description: Topic the plugin publishes ON or OFF to after each state change. Use as state_topic in a Home Assistant MQTT switch.

default_label.title: Default Label
default_label.description: Text displayed when activated. Can be overridden per-message via MQTT JSON payload.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: RGB color of the label text. Default is white [255, 255, 255].

background_color.title: Background Color
background_color.description: RGB background color. Default is broadcast red [200, 10, 10].

font_path.title: Font Path
font_path.description: Path to a TTF font file, relative to the LEDMatrix root (e.g. assets/fonts/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf). Leave blank to use the built-in display font.

font_size.title: Font Size (px)
font_size.description: Font height in pixels. Set to 0 for auto-sizing based on display height. Only applies when Font Path is set.

ha_discovery.title: Home Assistant Auto-Discovery
ha_discovery.description: Publish MQTT discovery payloads on connect so Home Assistant automatically creates the device and entities. No configuration.yaml entry needed.

discovery_prefix.title: Discovery Prefix
discovery_prefix.description: MQTT topic prefix used by your HA MQTT integration. Leave as 'homeassistant' unless you changed it in HA.

device_name.title: Device Name
device_name.description: How the device appears in Home Assistant under Settings → Devices & Services → MQTT.

display_duration.title: Display Duration (s)
display_duration.description: How long the On Air sign stays on screen per rotation cycle while active.
